intro: Illustrative Manuscripts wires published catalogs and open transcriptions — it does not replace them. Use this hub to jump to the wheels scholars already built: INTF registers, full CNTR, Corpus Coranicum, Claremont IIIF, and public-domain historical apparatus scans.

license_legend.open_reuse: Data or scans you may reuse under stated terms (CC BY, CC BY-SA, public domain). We link or compile; check each source.
license_legend.link_only: Cite and follow outbound links — do not rehost images or proprietary databases on this site.
license_legend.copyrighted_cite_only: Standard critical editions (NA28, ECM, UBS). Cite in papers; we never host apparatus text or scans.

sections.title: Greek New Testament
sections.intro: Mechanical collation on this site is a bounded CNTR slice vs SR GNT. Full tradition work stays with INTF, CNTR, and edition houses.

cards.title: INTF Liste & NTVMR
cards.summary: Gregory–Aland sigla, date ranges, contents, and manuscript workspace — the register behind “how many Greek NT manuscripts exist.”
cards.license_note: Catalog metadata and images via institutional terms — link out; we do not mirror the Liste.

cards.title: CNTR transcriptions & SR GNT
cards.summary: Open diplomatic Greek, Society of Biblical Literature Greek New Testament (SR GNT) base text, and tools our variant census reuses.
cards.license_note: CC BY-SA 4.0 transcriptions — our census fields remain share-alike when derived.

cards.title: IGNTP
cards.summary: Institute for New Testament Textual Research critical editions and open tools where published (e.g. Catholic Epistles, Pauline projects).
cards.license_note: Per-edition terms — use for apparatus judgments we do not encode.

cards.title: Gurry 2016 — tradition-scale variant estimates
cards.summary: Peter J. Gurry’s accepted manuscript on how many variants the Greek NT tradition may hold (~500k order-of-magnitude) — context for Ehrman-scale debate, not our census total.
cards.license_note: Article paywall may apply; accepted MS PDF is open at Cambridge.

cards.title: Tischendorf Editio octava critica maior (Internet Archive)
cards.summary: 19th-century public-domain critical edition with historical apparatus — useful for famous passages, not a substitute for NA28/ECM.
cards.license_note: Public-domain scans — link for apparatus; we do not OCR-ingest bulk text here.

cards.title: NA28 · ECM · UBS Greek New Testament
cards.summary: Current critical editions of record for citations and classroom — apparatus judgments and copyrighted text.
cards.license_note: Buy or library-access — never host apparatus or text on this site.

sections.title: Qurʾān
sections.intro: Our Qurʾān layers transcribe published stemmatics and catalog cards — not a generated mushaf variant census.

cards.title: Corpus Coranicum
cards.summary: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy catalog spine, bibliography, and early manuscript metadata for Qurʾān research.
cards.license_note: CC BY 4.0 metadata — images and editions may have separate terms.

cards.title: Michael Cook (2004) — regional codex stemma
cards.summary: Published tallies for Uthmanic regional rasm splits (~35 graphic reports) that frame our layer-2 table.
cards.license_note: Cite the chapter; we reproduce illustrative rows with attribution, not a full re-count.

cards.title: Hythem Sidky (2020) — manuscript phylogeny
cards.summary: Four ancestral nodes recovered from early manuscript trees — cited on Uthmanic rasm and shared-orthography pages.
cards.license_note: Journal article — link for phylogeny claims; no bulk ingest.

cards.title: Marijn van Putten (2019) — BSOAS Table 2
cards.summary: niʿmat allāh / ta vs ta marbūṭa matrix we hand-transcribed for the shared-orthography layer.
cards.license_note: Open-access article — matrix on /quran/archetype/ mirrors Table 2, not independent collation.

sections.title: Hebrew Bible & Septuagint
sections.intro: Timeline cards use named public-domain plates and institutional links listed in DATA.md — not BHQ or Göttingen dumps.

cards.title: Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library
cards.summary: IAA/Qumran image and catalog backbone for DSS Hebrew witnesses we point to.
cards.license_note: Institutional image terms — we embed or link per license; no full plate rehost.

cards.title: DigiVatLib (Vatican Library)
cards.summary: IIIF and catalog access for codices such as Vaticanus where we outbound-link Greek and Hebrew holdings.
cards.license_note: Link-only for most high-res manuscript views.

cards.title: Named PD plates (DATA.md)
cards.summary: Commons and publication scans we may host when license allows — documented per file in the repository.
cards.license_note: Per-file license in .attribution.json sidecars — check before reuse.

cards.title: Claremont Colleges Digital Library — NHA
cards.summary: IIIF embeds for Nag Hammadi codices on our tractate cards.
cards.license_note: IIIF embed only on this site — physical rights retained by holding institutions.
